scraperConfig.analyzerNotes: The page displays all 17 matching jobs in a single page with no pagination controls visible (job count shows "1 to 17 of 17"). Each job card is a div.card.card-job with a data-id attribute holding the job reference (e.g. "jr126863"). The external_id can be read from the card's data-id attribute, but since field_selectors are CSS selectors for text/href content, it is noted here: use the attribute [data-id] on the card itself. The job-meta list has 3 items: company (1st), job function (2nd), location (3rd). The detail_url href is relative (e.g. /en/jobs/jr126863/...) and should be resolved against the base URL https://careers.richemont.com. No salary, posted date, or description snippet is present in the listing cards. The pagesize=20 URL param controls results per page but since all 17 results fit on one page, pagination_type is none.
